About

I'm a third-year B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at Jyothi Engineering College, Thrissur, under APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University, carrying a CGPA of 8.57. My work sits at the intersection of full-stack engineering and emerging technology — I like taking a system apart, understanding every layer, and rebuilding it better.

That shows up in projects like QuantumMed, a hybrid quantum-classical cancer detection pipeline, and in hands-on internships spanning IoT, AI agents, and Android development. I currently serve as Public Relations Officer for the IE(I) CSE Student Chapter at JEC, and previously led membership development for the IEEE Student Branch.

Outside coursework, I've represented my team twice at the NASA International Space Apps Challenge, and I'm constantly looking for the next hard problem to build my way through.
